items.title: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly weighs Jensen Huang’s future
items.brief: Nvidia shares dropped sharply in after-hours trading on Wednesday after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital relationship with a company executive and that the board is meeting to discuss his future.

items.title: At least 1 dead and 12 injured after 3-story Brooklyn building collapses, officials say
items.brief: At least one person is dead and 12 others injured after a three-story building in Brooklyn collapsed Wednesday afternoon, a fire department official said.

items.title: Clinging to life and crying, a baby was found buried alive a day after his father took him, investigators say
items.brief: Trapped in a dog crate and entombed beneath a foot of dirt, a South Carolina infant miraculously survived 24 hours buried underground, authorities say.

items.title: Look out for fireballs as the Northern Taurid meteor shower reaches its peak
items.brief: Those who missed last week’s Southern Taurids meteor shower have another chance to watch a fireball blaze across the sky, as the Northern Taurids reach their peak.

items.title: Russian ambassador to US dies suddenly, foreign ministry says
items.brief: Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, died in Moscow aged 66, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.
